Hey, so first of all try to get the basics down: holding aggro and surviving that.   Once you have that try improving your positioning, and by extension the positioning of the mobs you are tanking, you want to stack them into each other so you can bomb them down, unless there is a mechanic that discourages that.   Once you have that down try your hand at cooldown management, it makes a big difference when you use your CDs, if you are a specific tank class and find yourself in a situation without any left Shield stacks, that's the perfect time to pop a CD to not take too much damage, and to build on that, you don't want to find yourself in a situation where you don't have Shield stacks for big damage intakes in the first place.   Once you can run medium difficult dungeons reliably try to increase your own damage output, while it is not the primary job of a tank, your own DPS is very significant especially in timed dungeons, I often find myself outdamaging damage dealers simply because I often use my damage cooldowns in between bosses to maximize its uptime, but you should't worry too much about thag for starters!

Many red maps have imo a bad layout or bad density, most people prefer to shape a map to a higher tier and run those, everything dies fast so XP is great.   High atlas bonus makes sustaining those higher tiers much easier.

If you want to farm for items I'd suggest first shaping specific rooms, then uncomplete lower tier maps except for specific rooms, make sure you still have about 70% Atlas bonus, uncompleting can be expensive but it's going to be cheaper than buying the maps all the time.   For starters, buy a 15% iiq Sadimas and the cheapest Goldwyrm with the highest iiq you can reasonably get, then get a good rolled thiefs torment.   For belt you can go Biscos Leash or a Stygian Vise to help with resists, helmet you can go Devotos or Lightpoacher (2 socket might be too expensive), for quiver you can often get one with crit, some ele dmg and some resists for quite cheap.   Be sure to still have a bit of currency left over to get a few Abyss Jewels with ele dmg on attacks and fill all your  Jewel Sockets with them, you can try to grab a bit of resist here if you need to.   That should be plenty to get you started, the most expensive part will be the uncompleting and Tabula (you can also try to see if you find a corrupted 6l for cheap).
